description: The agent must: (1) Open `audit/legacy_permissions_manifest.txt` and parse all 8 entries. (2) For symbolic inputs (ENTRY_A through ENTRY_D, ENTRY_H), convert to numeric using the bit-sum rules; for numeric inputs (ENTRY_E, ENTRY_F, ENTRY_G), convert to symbolic. (3) Apply the SKILL.md's special-bit rules: setuid with execute present → lowercase 's' in owner position (ENTRY_A); setgid with execute present → lowercase 's' in group position (ENTRY_B); sticky with execute present → lowercase 't' in others position (ENTRY_C, ENTRY_G); setgid WITHOUT execute → uppercase 'S' in group position (ENTRY_F = 2640); setuid WITHOUT execute → uppercase 'S' in owner position (ENTRY_H = rwSr--r-- → 4644). (4) Generate both chmod commands: numeric form (`chmod XXXX filename`) and symbolic form using `u+`, `g+`, `o+` clauses — critically, entities with ZERO permissions must be OMITTED from the symbolic command (ENTRY_E has others=000 so no `o+` clause), and special bits use `u+s`, `g+s`, `+t`. (5) Include a security warning on ENTRY_G (1777). (6) Write all results as a JSON array to `permissions_reference.json`.
